primaryEvidence.notes: Neighbor-only deterministic scan. Broader source results using adjacency queries and quantum access are outside this pair.

versionEvidence: The HTML displays arXiv:2502.06024v1 (9 February 2025) and an internal manuscript date of 24 August 2026. The abstract history lists only v1; no later revision number is asserted.

scope.graph: Undirected simple graph with known labeled vertex set [n], n≥1, m edges, maximum degree Δ.
scope.access: Neighbor(v,j) returns the j-th neighbor in a fixed arbitrary ordering, or ⊥ when j>d(v).
scope.output: An explicit color for every vertex; n vertex–color assignments.
scope.correctness: Deterministic; correct on every input satisfying the graph and oracle promises.

derivations.queryCount: Sum of undirected degrees is 2m; add one list-end test per known vertex.
derivations.time: Timestamp marks and scanning for an available color cost O(d(v)+1) per vertex.
derivations.palette: Previously colored neighbors forbid at most d(v) colors.

corrections.change: Replaced a forced quadratic-exponent point with exact n+2m neighbor calls. Retained O(nΔ) as the source's coarse Δ≥1 convention; added end tests and isolated-vertex accounting.

noLowerTransfer: No applicable neighbor-only query lower bound is verified by this bounded one-record review. No matrix, combined-access or quantum lower bound is transferred.
excluded: Matrix/combined-access randomized and quantum algorithms from the paper are not plotted in this neighbor-only deterministic baseline.
No claim that n+2m is necessary for arbitrary coloring algorithms.
No assumed degree oracle, known Δ, or hidden list-length metadata.

validation.isolatedTests: Passed: 12 viewport sizes; all 1,099 labeled simple graphs with 1≤n≤5 verify exact n+2m calls, n end tests and proper Δ+1 coloring; source filtering, keyboard inspector and lifecycle.
validation.schema: In-memory build.validate/load_pairs overlay passed: 231 papers, 151 slices, 406 results and 30 registered pairs.
validation.staticVisuals: 738×548 detail and 330×245 compact inspected in light/dark; overview is textless. CSS provides horizontal scrolling for a 360px focus container.
validation.pending: Root shared integration, live browser QA, output refresh and completion notification.
